lidl.name: Lidl

amazon.name: Amazon
amazon.store: amazon.com listing price, sold by Amazon itself (no third-party sellers), as seen from a New Jersey connection (marked NJ price). Price varies, may include shipping; the date it was read is on each card.
amazon.source: amazon.com public search and product pages
amazon.own_brands: Amazon Grocery (formerly Happy Belly / Amazon Fresh), Amazon Basics, Solimo, Aplenty

costco.name: Costco

Costco membership required; warehouse price may differ by location. Compared per unit.
costco.source: costco.com public search and product pages
